DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS NETWORK CONTRACTING OFFICE 21 (NCO 21)

Description: THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE FOR A REQUEST FOR QUOTE (RFQ). 

VA Sierra Nevada Health Care System (VASNHCS)has a future need for Top Door Alarm System Annual Certification for the VA Sierra Nevada Health Care System (VASNHCS) located at 975 Kirman Ave, Reno, NV 89502-0993. 

Solicitation Number 36C26126Q0573 for this effort will be posted to SAM.GOV (https://sam.gov) on or about April 6, 2026.  This solicitation will contain all necessary specifications and information necessary to quote the project.
See solicitation for when questions must be submitted. 
Quotes are tentatively scheduled to be due on Monday, April 20, 2026 (see solicitation when available for specific time/date).

Point of Contact: Gary Christensen, Contract Specialist, gary.christensen@va.gov. 

Questions regarding this notice may be submitted via e-mail to gary.christensen@va.gov.
